## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M4 - Data Augmentation.

## Technical Scope

- Python-based CLI and callable function integration
- Input dataset support for JSON and CSV
- Validation and filtering of generated samples before merge/export
- Execution against project-hosted or external OpenAI-compatible endpoints
- Intended for controlled experimentation and dataset preparation

## Run Guidance

python -m <module_entry> --input <dataset> --output <augmented_dataset>

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
